# umami_website_share (Resource)

A public share link for a website's dashboard, served at `<umami url>/share/<slug>`. Anyone with the link can view the selected pages without logging in. A website can have several shares.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "umami_website" "app" {
  name   = "Example app"
  domain = "app.example.com"
}

resource "umami_website_share" "client" {
  website_id   = umami_website.app.id
  name         = "Client dashboard"
  slug         = "example-app"
  views        = ["overview", "events", "realtime"]
  allow_filter = false
}

output "share_url" {
  value = "https://analytics.example.com/share/${umami_website_share.client.slug}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the share, shown in the website settings.
- `website_id` (String) ID of the website to share.

### Optional

- `allow_filter` (Boolean) Whether viewers can filter the shared data. Defaults to `true`.
- `slug` (String) Path segment of the share URL. Slugs are unique across the Umami instance. Generated by Umami when omitted.
- `theme` (String) Theme of the shared page, `light` or `dark`. Follows the viewer's system setting when omitted.
- `views` (Set of String) Pages the share exposes. One or more of `overview`, `events`, `sessions`, `realtime`, `performance`, `compare`, `breakdown`, `goals`, `funnels`, `journeys`, `retention`, `utm`, `revenue`, `attribution`. Defaults to `overview` and `events`, as in the Umami UI.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID of the share, in the form `website_id/share_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the website ID and share ID, separated by a slash.
terraform import umami_website_share.client 0f3c9a3e-7f4d-5b8a-9c1e-2d3f4a5b6c7d/35c22b8a-14c0-4cf8-ac51-992a875d9918
```
